findings.title: Invalidate descendant geometry when behavior-resolved layout changes
findings.evidence: invalidateBehaviorStyle detects any layoutStyleDiff but markChanged targets only the root. measure reuses descendants solely on their layoutDirty flag. refresh then replaces resolved style without invalidating constrainedWidth, and constrain returns cached lines/height at equal width. arrange can also reuse descendant geometry since its dirty flag remains clear.
findings.counterexample: Column { Text(abcdef).width(3).focusable(true).setStyle(textWrap, Value(Grapheme), state:Focused); Text(Z).focusable(true) }. Snapshot at 3x4 starts with abc, def, Z. Request focus on Z. Source predicts M2 retains def and Z at row 2 whereas complete M1 has abc then Z at row 1.
findings.execution_status: not executed; independent public regression requested through parent
findings.remediation: Compare and invalidate effective layout inputs on every affected descendant before reusing its measurement or geometry; do not rely on root-only invalidation.

findings.kind: original Unit C requirement not implemented
findings.title: Classify reusable-style and visual-state changes by effective output
findings.evidence: applyStyles and applyStates unconditionally mark Layout for unequal declarations/states. RuntimeSession immediately discards root layout and marks ancestors, and no subsequent resolved-output comparison changes this classification.
findings.counterexample: Change a Text inline StyleUse from a foreground-only red rule to a foreground-only blue rule; alternatively toggle visualStates where only foreground changes. Target remeasures and arranges although all geometry inputs are equal.
findings.test_boundary: typed_style_equality tests identical lists, not changed lists with only paint differences.
findings.remediation: Separate reevaluation/declaration changes from effective geometry changes for these public entrypoints.

findings.title: Coalesce redundant notifications without losing cutoff generations
contract: original C135 cutoff and resource review
findings.evidence: Every out-of-domain notify increments invalidationSequence. Since sequence differs from the prior pending record, it appends another record. Neither notify nor RuntimeLimits bounds pendingNodes. evaluateReady later processes every duplicate. The base coalesced one pending record per node.
findings.counterexample: A worker issues N Style notifications on one mounted node before the UI pumps; the fixed candidate retains N PendingNodeChange objects and later performs N redundant effective invalidations.
findings.remediation: Retain the necessary before/after-cutoff categories or generations in bounded/coalesced pending metadata, instead of one record per notification.

findings.kind: original Unit C propagation cutoff missing
findings.title: Stop dependency propagation at unchanged effective outputs and inputs
contract: design section 5 dependency rules and affected sibling scan
findings.evidence: Content/Layout/Structure always erase the root result and dirty the complete ancestor chain before measuring; there is no comparison of parent-to-parent output or dependency inputs. When the implicit root geometry path runs, summarizeVerticalOverflow recursively computes allocations and records arranges even in clean non-barrier subtrees.
findings.counterexample: A default root contains independent nested auto-height panels. Replace one leaf with same-width/same-height text. Other panels remain geometrically unchanged but their complete finite overflow allocation summaries are recomputed.
findings.test_boundary: local_content uses fixed-height panels, which trigger summary barriers; its reduced total arrange check does not prove unrelated auto-height subtrees avoid work.
findings.remediation: Cache/reuse effective dependency outputs and overflow summaries; propagate only changed relevant inputs while retaining necessary internal arrangements.

findings.kind: inherited accounting gap within original C scope
findings.title: Count actual final finite Canvas measurement misses
contract: design section 5 count all executed measurement stages
findings.evidence: constrainCanvasFinal calls canvas.measure for a new finite width/height but does not call recordMeasure. The natural and width-constrained stages alone increment measures. New cache hits make this visible as zero reported measurement despite a final-stage miss.
findings.counterexample: Render a root Canvas.viewport(ScrollAxes.Off), then snapshot at the same width and a different height. constrain(width) returns its cached result; constrainCanvasFinal calls measure with new maxHeight while measures delta remains zero.
findings.provenance: Final-stage omission exists in base 107ef32; original C contract still requires honest accounting for cache reuse and actual constraint stages.
findings.remediation: Increment the existing measure counter on each actual final-stage miss, including M1 work, while excluding hits and theme preview.
